policy: MVP links-first source storage; no persistent archive of public downloads
supersedes: Earlier source-retention notes requiring downloads solely for offline report builds or source validation describe historical snapshots and no longer govern this MVP.
retained: Authored research notes, protocols and review records
Original URLs, document identities/versions, access dates, hashes and page locators
Short evidence quotations and recorded check results
Historical authored reports and their frozen review inputs

kinds: Full text, OCR and browser captures

recovery_limits: No new URLs were guessed. Manifest entries without an authenticated direct recovery URL require consulting the preserved source metadata. Regenerable derivatives are not treated as original-source downloads. Changed or unavailable live bytes must be disclosed; restoration is not a new factual check.
validation: Routine validators check saved records without downloading or rechecking original bytes. Explicit --check-local-sources requires only the originals needed for that task, which should be removed afterward.
historical_builder: research/reviews/build_resolution_followup-frozen.py preserves the authored code identity bound by the earlier review freeze; current record validation uses that frozen identity without rewriting the review.
scope_note: Authored files in the separate ongoing unresolved-hour-20261026 pass were left untouched.
